sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cunomaglus is a sometime epithet of the Gaulish Apollo. The compound carries a hound-prince or hound-lord reading, a modern sense drawn from its two parts. The title shows how worshippers paired a god of light with hound imagery. Readers seeking the god himself should follow the Apollo entry.

okr.objective: Cunomaglus is a name of the god Apollo given by a cross reference.
